```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Load libraries ----
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(rstan)
```

```{r}
# specify folder with model results
# if in two folders, move stanfit objects into the first folder

folder_path <- c(paste0("results/models/adrd/m1/model_run_20240307/"),
                 paste0("results/models/adrd/m2/model_run_20240307/"),
                 paste0("results/models/adrd/m3/model_run_20240308/"),
                 paste0("results/models/hosp/m2/model_run_20240315/"))

# loop through these folders
for (i in 1:length(folder_path)) {
  
  # get files that start with "stanfit_object_"
  stanfit_files <- grep("^stanfit_object_", list.files(folder_path[i]), value = TRUE)
  
  print(paste0("Model: ", folder_path[i], ", n chains: ", length(stanfit_files)))
  
  # read these files into a list
  stanfit_list <- list()
  
  # loop through available chains
  for (j in 1:length(stanfit_files)) {
    stanfit_list[[j]] <- read_rds(paste0(folder_path[i], stanfit_files[j]))
    }
  
  # Convert the list of model fits to a stan fit object
  stanfit_object <- sflist2stanfit(stanfit_list)
  
  # save for scripts 5 and 6
  write_rds(stanfit_object, file = paste0(folder_path[i], "stanfit_object.rds"))
  
}
```
